description:
A studio project, stored as `<workspace>/<id>/project.json`.

Unknown top-level keys are kept on round-trip, so a newer studio's fields and hand-added keys
survive a save by this studio. `upstream` holds the rlgym-learn configuration verbatim as opaque
JSON; the studio does not interpret it here.

archived.description: Archived projects are hidden by default.

id.description: The project's folder name: lowercase `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`, 1 to 64 characters. Immutable: renaming a project changes `name` only.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the project file format. This schema describes version 1.

upstream.description: The rlgym-learn configuration, verbatim and opaque to this schema. Empty (`null` or absent) until 0.3.0.

title: ProjectFile
